items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: So, uh, played with John Joseph, and Buddy Charles was playing guitar. We had a trio.

ctx.x: Yeah, they call him Papa John.

Yeah, Papa John, that's right. Yeah, John Joseph, you see? Yeah, sure, I know him, yeah. Yeah, see? So, uh, played with John Joseph, and Buddy Charles was playing guitar. We had a trio. And Papa John was old at that time, so, you know, he's still old. He's very old now. So, uh, but then after I left the, left the Dewdrop, I worked there about a year playing piano, maybe better than a year. I was playing piano, but then I got to be pretty good at it, you know? Uh-huh. Then we went at another place on Claiborne…
